description: This file contains PHP unit tests for the LDAPDao class within the OrangeHRM project, testing LDAP-related functionalities such as retrieving employees, users, and LDAP sync statuses.

classes.name: LDAPDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the LDAPDao, verifying LDAP operations such as retrieving employees, users, auth providers, and sync statuses.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up test environment by loading LDAP test fixtures.

methods.name: testGetEmpNumbersHaveManyUsers
methods.description: Tests retrieval of employee numbers with multiple associated users.

methods.name: testGetNonLocalUserByUserName
methods.description: Tests retrieval of non-local users by username, including cases with non-existing, deleted, disabled, local, LDAP, and non-LDAP users.

methods.name: testGetUserByUsername
methods.description: Tests retrieval of users by username, including non-existing, deleted, disabled, local, LDAP, and multi-auth users.

methods.name: testGetEmployee
methods.description: Tests fetching employee details with various search parameters, expecting Employee objects with correct data, and handling of ambiguous results.

methods.name: testGetAuthProviderByUserUniqueId
methods.description: Tests lookup of LDAP auth providers by user unique ID.

methods.name: testGetAllLDAPAuthProviders
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of all LDAP authentication providers.

methods.name: testSaveLdapSyncStatus
methods.description: Tests saving LDAP synchronization status and verifies all properties.

methods.name: testGetLastLdapSyncStatus
methods.description: Checks retrieval of the most recent LDAP sync status.
